root.label: Australian government orders legacy technology stocktake

events.label: Australian government orders legacy technology stocktake

slots.name: cyber upgrade funding
slots.sentence: The finance minister, Katy Gallagher, asked her department whether some of the A$160m funding allocated to the agency in the last budget for cyber upgrades can be accelerated.

slots.name: stocktake order date
slots.sentence: This week, the home affairs department ordered all federal government agencies to conduct a “legacy technology stocktake”
